remarks: Sought after Chesterfield Condo Community. Move in ready and beautifully updated 1 Bedroom - 1.5 bath Townhome. This Lido model unit  is designed with an open floor plan, Vaulted ceiling living room with a wood burning fireplace, skylights and slider to own deck. Upper-level features Bedroom with a walk-in closet and a fabulous super spacious bathroom with a separate shower, jetted tub and double sinks. New Washer/Dryer and Microwave. This gated community with gorgeous grounds, 2 in-ground pools and proximity to Vibrant downtown Stamford is a perfect place to live. Convenient to Fitness centers, Scalzi Park, Ridgeway Shopping Center, Coffee Shops and restaurants. Tenant responsible for all utilities. Excellent credit report, job history and references required. Owner reserves the right to interview prospective tenant.  Agent/co-owner
